story.p2: We roast for the bar, not the shelf — small lots, honest tasting notes, and a counter that never feels rushed.

aboutPage.title: Built for better mornings.
aboutPage.p1: {name} began as a small counter with one espresso machine and a stubborn belief that coffee shops should feel calm — not rushed, not loud for the sake of it.
aboutPage.p2: We roast relationships first: rotating microlots, dialed recipes, and a short food list that pairs with what’s in the cup.
aboutPage.p3: Today the room on Mercer Street is where neighbors start their day, meet mid-afternoon, or simply sit with a pour-over and a book.
aboutPage.imageAlt: Warm café interior with soft morning light
aboutPage.step1Body: One machine, twelve seats, and a weekly rotating filter coffee.
aboutPage.step2Body: We shortened the menu, added a quiet kitchen, and began hosting small cuppings.
aboutPage.step3Body: More window light, softer music, and wholesale beans for cafés that share the same pace.
aboutPage.sourcingBody: We buy small lots from importers we trust, taste every arrival, and keep tasting cards honest — origin, process, and what we actually taste in the cup.

faqPage.title: Common questions from the counter.
faqPage.lede: Short answers about hours, milk, allergens, pickup, and the room — ask us anything else in person or by note.
faqPage.seoDescription: FAQ for Solace Coffee — hours, dietary options, pickup, private hire, and the room.
faqPage.a1: Weekdays 7:00–19:00 and weekends 8:00–18:00. The live open status on Visit updates through the day.
faqPage.q2: Do you have oat or other alternative milks?
faqPage.a2: Yes — oat is always on the bar, with rotating dairy-free options. Ask for today’s list.
faqPage.a3: The kitchen handles dairy, eggs, gluten, and tree nuts. Tell the bar about allergies; menu tags are a guide, not a guarantee.
faqPage.a4: Yes. Laptops are welcome until the afternoon rush — we keep music soft so the room stays calm.
faqPage.a5: Build a bag on the Order page. We’ll confirm by email; payment stays at the counter in this demo flow.
faqPage.q6: Can I book a private tasting or hire the room?
faqPage.a6: Yes. See Events for public cuppings and the private-hire section for capacity and packages.
faqPage.a7: The entrance and main seating are step-free. Reach out if you need a quieter table or other accommodations.
faqPage.a8: Dogs are welcome on the patio when weather allows. Inside stays reserved for guests without pets.

carePage.title: Access, allergens, and a quieter room.
carePage.lede: How we try to make Solace workable for more bodies, diets, and rhythms — ask the bar anytime if you need something we missed.
carePage.accessBody: Step-free entrance and main seating. Reach out ahead if you need a quieter table or other accommodations.
carePage.quietBody: Music stays soft. Laptops are welcome until the afternoon rush so conversation can still find space.
carePage.allergenBody: The kitchen handles dairy, eggs, gluten, and tree nuts. Menu tags guide — they are not a guarantee. Download the stub allergen card or tell the bar.
carePage.serviceBody: We can walk through oat and other milks, GF pastry availability that day, and seating that feels calmer.
carePage.seoDescription: Accessibility, allergen care, and quiet-room notes for Solace Coffee.
